d:
At the launch event of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love,' Lok Sabha LoP and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi said, 'What you're reading in this book is my mum before Papa died. Not once, I'll tell you, she's written twice cancer survivor, three times cancer, right? She's a four-time cancer survivor. So she plays it all down. Not once in my life have I seen her scared. Not once have I seen her back down. The reason I wanted to give this speech is because, Mummy, Papa loved you, but I cannot even tell you how proud he would be of you.'
